title: What the Bronson band played in 1928
summary: The Bronson band played the same dance music as Lester's father's band, and Lester got his tenor in January 1928.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: You were talking about Lester back then getting on the tenor when he joined Bronson's band, and getting that Pan-American tenor saxophone.
Yeah, he got that. It was a good horn. A good-playing horn.
So this was in January of '28 when he got on that horn and he got in Bronson's band.
So what kind of numbers was Bronson's band doing and what kind of show? You mentioned the musicians already.
